description: Synthetic agy fixture. Unlike the other providers, the conversation database is generated at test time by setup_agy_tree() in tests/cli.rs instead of being sanitized from a real store: agy keeps conversation content in opaque protobuf blobs inside SQLite, so sanitizing a real database in place is not reliable and would risk shipping private content. The generated database reproduces the real schema (trajectory_meta + steps) and the real step layout.

step_types.14: user input, body field 19, prompt text at sub-field 2
step_types.15: agent response, body field 20, visible text at sub-field 1, reasoning at sub-field 3
step_types.23: task summary, body field 30, conversation title at sub-field 4
step_types.8: tool activity, skipped by the reader
